title: 第5章 她要换掉这门婚约
lines: 镇北王醒来三日后，圣旨到了。
内侍捧着金盘，一路小跑入偏殿。
身后跟着的，是礼部官员与两名太医。
整个京城都在等一个结果——
苏晚救王爷有功，必有重赏。
封号、金银、甚至可能入太医院，或赐府出宫。
所有人都已经替她想好了路。
可偏殿里，苏晚只是坐着。
她一口一口喝完，才抬头。
他见过很多等圣旨的人。
有跪着的，有抖着的，有笑着的。
像她这样“等吃完药再说”的。
“医女苏晚，救镇北王于危难之际，功在社稷……”
“赐府邸一座，准其自由出入宫禁……”
每一句，都足以改变一个人的命运。
太医已经忍不住看向她。
content_zh:
相府的夜，比白日更沉。

    沉得像一口合上的棺。

    老太君的房里，灯火通明，却没有一丝暖意。

    空气里弥漫着浓重的药味。

    太医跪在床前，手都在抖。

    “回相爷……老太君这次是真的不行了。”

    “气机尽散，回天乏术……”

    一句“回天乏术”，像刀一样落下。

    相爷脸色铁青。

    继母站在一侧，眼神却异常冷静。

    她甚至没有去看床上的老太君。

    因为她知道——

    这一步，是她等的。

    老太君一死，府中权力彻底重分。

    而苏晚，也会被顺势压回“废物”的位置。

    一切，都刚刚好。

    “让开。”

    一道声音从门口传来。

    很轻。

    却像针一样刺破了整个房间的死气。

    所有人回头。

    苏晚站在门口。

    依旧是一身素衣。

    依旧是那副安静得过分的样子。

    太医先炸了。

    “你来做什么？！老太君已经——”

    苏晚打断他。

    “还没死。”

    太医冷笑。

    “气息全无！你看不见吗！”

    苏晚看他一眼。

    “我看见了。”

    她走进来。

    一步一步。

    没有任何慌乱。

    也没有任何悲悯。

    只是平静。

    平静得让人不安。

    继母终于开口。

    声音温和。

    “苏晚。”

    “这里不是你可以胡闹的地方。”

    苏晚没看她。

    “她还能活。”

    继母轻轻一笑。

    “你确定？”

    苏晚点头。

    “确定。”

    相爷皱眉。

    “你凭什么？”

    苏晚终于抬头。

    看向床榻。

    老太君脸色灰白，气息几乎断绝。

    但在她眼里——

    不是死。

    是“被封住”。

    她轻声说：

    “凭她还有一线气。”

    太医怒极：

    “胡说八道！”

    “你连脉都没把！”

    苏晚没有解释。

    她直接走到床前。

    伸手。

    搭脉。
content_en:
The direction of the Prime Minister's Mansion has changed very quickly.

    Yesterday she was still a "waste legitimate daughter".

    Today no one dares to say these four words in person.

    But just because no one said it, it didn't mean they didn't want to see her laugh.

    Especially Su Rou.

    At noon, the Prime Minister's Mansion held a banquet.

    The name is to pray for the "old lady's recovery".

    In fact, it was a signal to several powerful people in Beijing——

    The Prime Minister's Office is "still stable".

    But everyone knew very well that the real protagonist of this banquet was not the old lady.

    It's Su Wan.

    The banquet has not yet started, but the courtyard is already full of people.

    Several official ladies and young masters from the capital came.

    They come not to bless.

    Went to see a show.

    Look at the Prime Minister's daughter who "rescued people", "poisoned" and was "cleansed" overnight, what kind of thing is she?

    When Su Wan came in, the whole place was quiet for a moment.

    Then——

    Whispers began.

    "That's her?"

    "I heard that she was exposed and poisoned by Miss Su Rou yesterday."

    "She also said that she saved the old lady... is it true or not?"

    "I think it's mostly pretending."

    "How could the prime minister's daughter-in-law be such a person..."

    Those aren't loud.

    But it's harsh enough.

    Su Rou sat next to the main seat, the corners of her mouth raised slightly.

    She said nothing.

    But she knew——

    This is her real game.

    Not a frame-up.

    It's "humiliation".

    She wanted Su Wan to completely lose her position as the "prime minister's daughter" in front of everyone.

    The stepmother coughed lightly.

    The banquet begins.

    Food and wine are served.

    The atmosphere seems harmonious.

    But every pair of eyes was secretly looking at Su Wan.

    Wait for her to make a mistake.

    Wait for her to lose her composure.

    Wait for her to "show her flaws."

    Finally, someone spoke.

    She is a young lady from a noble family in Beijing.

    She held the wine glass and smiled gently.

    "Sister Su is so lucky."

    "I heard that I saved the old lady yesterday, and today I was proven innocent."

    "It's really... enviable."

    Beautifully said.

    But the word "innocent" is deliberately given a heavy emphasis.

    People around him chuckled.

    Su Rou lowered her head to drink tea, with a smile hidden in her eyes.

    Su Wan looked up at her.

    No words were spoken.

    Seeing that she didn't answer, the young lady continued.

    "I just heard that Sister Su has been weak since she was a child, and even her meridians are blocked."

    "But suddenly he understands medical skills."

    "It's really... curious."

    A word of "curiosity".

    It's already a knife.

    The atmosphere at the banquet became slightly tense.

    Everyone was waiting for Su Wan's reaction.

    Are you panicking?

    Is it anger?

    Or an explanation?

    Su Rou gently put down the tea cup.

    very good.

    here we go.

    Su Wan finally spoke.

    The voice is very soft.

    "Are you curious?"

    The young lady was stunned.

    "Natural."

    Su Wan nodded.

    "Then you can continue to be curious."
